domain_title: Architecture, security, robustness, safety and evaluation
title: Demo-based quality assurance
canonical_definition: Successful examples or generic model benchmarks are treated as proof of end-to-end reliability.

conditions: All AI systems; metrics and thresholds must match intended purpose and consequence.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Demo-based quality assurance: Successful examples or generic model benchmarks are treated as proof of end-to-end reliability.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show happy-path-only examples, a single successful run, or average scores hiding critical failures?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Demo-based quality assurance, or does it remain unknown?

conditions: Refer verified demo-based quality assurance to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MEASURE 2.1 (PDF p. 34), MEASURE 2.3 (PDF p. 34), MEASURE 2.4 (PDF p. 34), MEASURE 2.5 (PDF p. 34)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on documenting evaluation methods and demonstrating performance under representative conditions. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where quality claims rely on demonstrations, isolated examples or generic model benchmarks alone. The mechanism can have an operational effect where the release passed despite unresolved critical scenarios, or the reported average concealed a material failure distribution.
potential_consequences: A consequential workflow may fail in conditions excluded by the release evidence.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether quality claims rely on demonstrations, isolated examples or generic model benchmarks alone. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether the release passed despite unresolved critical scenarios, or the reported average concealed a material failure distribution. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review independently rerun sampled scenarios and reconcile failures, acceptance thresholds, fallback and recorded progression decisions. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether quality claims rely on demonstrations, isolated examples or generic model benchmarks alone. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether the release passed despite unresolved critical scenarios, or the reported average concealed a material failure distribution. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide independently rerun sampled scenarios and reconcile failures, acceptance thresholds, fallback and recorded progression decisions. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Independently rerun sampled scenarios and reconcile failures, acceptance thresholds, fallback and recorded progression decisions.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether quality claims rely on demonstrations, isolated examples or generic model benchmarks alone, and separately check whether the release passed despite unresolved critical scenarios, or the reported average concealed a material failure distribution. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use independently rerun sampled scenarios and reconcile failures, acceptance thresholds, fallback and recorded progression decisions. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: Demonstrations can illustrate behavior when separate representative results support release claims.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in D2 alone cannot establish AP-D2 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows demo-based quality assurance
Implementation or operating evidence shows demo-based quality assurance
Presence or tested absence of demo-based quality assurance is unresolved within scope
